description: Cogito++ lightweight Gemini-Codex ownership and Git safety guard.

hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); [Console]::OutputEncoding = $utf8; $OutputEncoding = $utf8; $hookInput = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $hookPayload = $hookInput | ConvertFrom-Json; $cursor = [IO.DirectoryInfo]::new([string]$hookPayload.cwd); $hookScript = $null; while ($null -ne $cursor) { $candidate = Join-Path $cursor.FullName '.codex\hooks\cogito_hooks.py'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate -PathType Leaf) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $cursor.FullName 'AGENTS.md') -PathType Leaf) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $cursor.FullName '.git'))) { $hookScript = $candidate; break }; $cursor = $cursor.Parent }; if ($null -eq $hookScript) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Cogito++ hook script not found from payload cwd'); exit 2 }; $hookInput | & py -3 -B $hookScript; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
